import cadquery as cq

# PARAMETERS
flange_a_len = 60.0   # mm - length of horizontal flange (X)
flange_b_len = 40.0   # mm - length of vertical flange (Z)
width = 20.0           # mm - common width (Y)
thick = 3.0            # mm - material thickness
hole_d = 3.4           # mm - M3 clearance hole
hole_edge_margin = 10.0  # mm - margin from flange end to hole center

# Hole positions along horizontal flange (measured from x=0 origin)
hole1_x = hole_edge_margin
hole2_x = flange_a_len - hole_edge_margin
# Hole position along vertical flange (measured from z=0 origin)
hole3_z = flange_b_len - hole_edge_margin

# Horizontal flange: X 0..flange_a_len, Y -width/2..width/2, Z 0..thick
horiz = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=0)
    .center(flange_a_len / 2, 0)
    .box(flange_a_len, width, thick, centered=(True, True, False))
)

# Vertical flange: X 0..thick, Y -width/2..width/2, Z 0..flange_b_len
vert = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(thick / 2, 0)
    .box(thick, width, flange_b_len, centered=(True, True, False))
)

body = horiz.union(vert)

# Cut holes: two through horizontal flange (drilled along Z), one through vertical flange (drilled along X)
cyl1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-1)
    .moveTo(hole1_x, 0).circle(hole_d / 2).extrude(thick + 2)
)
cyl2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-1)
    .moveTo(hole2_x, 0).circle(hole_d / 2).extrude(thick + 2)
)
cyl3 = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ").workplane(offset=-1)
    .moveTo(0, hole3_z).circle(hole_d / 2).extrude(thick + 2)
)

result = body.cut(cyl1).cut(cyl2).cut(cyl3)

llmSteps.text: Made an L-bracket with a 60mm horizontal flange and 40mm vertical flange, 20mm wide, 3mm thick, with 3 M3 clearance holes (3.4mm) - two on the horizontal flange and one on the vertical flange, each 10mm from their respective ends. It prints flat with the horizontal flange on the bed; the overhang warning refers to the vertical flange's outer corner, which is a normal 90-degree bend and typically prints fine without supports at this scale.
